$comment: 全站游戏元数据唯一真源。所有登记点（vite 入口 / more-games / index 卡片 / sitemap / manifest / Workers 白名单 / 校验器页面清单 / README）一律由 tools/generators/gen-from-registry.mjs 从本文件派生（npm run gen）。caps 是校验器与迁移脚本的唯一判据：sidebar=有 .game-sidebar；drawer=接移动端统计抽屉；frame-budget=桌面舞台纵向预算（verify-desktop-frame 检查）；leaderboard=使用共享排行榜 Worker；daily=有每日挑战（键 <scores.dailyKeyPrefix>-YYYYMMDD）；analytics=客户端调用 hubTrack。layout=页面布局类型（缺省 standard；immersive = 顶栏以下整块视口归场景，见 docs/contracts/layout.md §7），互斥类型用独立字段而不是 cap。

desc.en: A 2D take on Minecraft. Mine blocks, craft tools, and build your world in the browser.

title.seo: Math Rain - Mathematical Expression Game

desc.meta: Math Rain 数字雨 — solve falling math equations before they land. Beat the timer, climb the streak and sharpen your mental arithmetic.

title.seo: Tetris - Cool Edition

desc.meta: Play Tetris - Cool Edition. A modern take on the classic puzzle game with particle effects and smooth animations.

desc.zh: 现代俄罗斯方块，支持 SRS 旋转、连击系统、多种主题与全球排行榜。

desc.meta: Play Gomoku (Five in a Row) online. Challenge the AI or play with a friend in this classic strategy board game.

desc.en: Five in a Row. Challenge the AI or play with a friend on the classic strategy board.

desc.meta: Planet Merge — drop planets, merge identical ones, chain combos and forge a sun in this addictive physics merge game. Daily challenge with a global leaderboard.
desc.og: Merge identical planets to forge a sun. Chain combos, beat the daily challenge, climb the global leaderboard.

title.doc: Word Daily — Daily Bilingual Word Puzzle
title.seo: Word Daily 每日猜词 — Daily Bilingual Word Puzzle

desc.meta: Word Daily 每日猜词 — a bilingual daily word puzzle. Guess the English word or the Chinese idiom (成语) in 6 tries. Same puzzle for everyone each day. Keep your streak, share your grid.

desc.twitter: Guess the word or the Chinese idiom in 6 tries. One puzzle a day.

desc.en: One puzzle a day for the whole world — guess the English word or the Chinese idiom in 6 tries. Keep your streak!

title.seo: Hoop Shot 街机投篮 — Flick Basketball Arcade

desc.meta: Hoop Shot 街机投篮 — flick the ball, arc it through the hoop, chain streaks for fire mode. One miss ends the run. Global top 10 leaderboard.

title.seo: Minesweeper 扫雷 — Classic Logic Puzzle

desc.meta: Minesweeper 扫雷 — the classic logic puzzle. Three difficulties, safe first click, chording, flags and a global fastest-clear leaderboard.
desc.og: The timeless mine-hunting puzzle. Safe first click, chording, three difficulties and a global fastest-clear leaderboard.
desc.twitter: The timeless mine-hunting puzzle. Clear the board without detonating a single mine.

desc.meta: Reversi 黑白棋 — classic Othello strategy. Play versus a tuned AI (three levels) or a friend, with flip animations and a global win-streak leaderboard.

desc.twitter: Flip your way to victory against a tuned AI or a friend.

desc.en: Classic Othello strategy. Outsmart a tuned AI on three levels or pass-and-play with a friend.

title.seo: Neon Tower Defense 霓虹塔防 — Strategy TD

desc.meta: Neon Tower Defense 霓虹塔防 — deploy four specialist towers across six future-city operations, survive 15 to 40 escalating waves and defend the energy core.
desc.og: Four specialist towers. Six tactical operations. Build, upgrade and defend a future-city energy core.
desc.twitter: Build, upgrade and defend the energy core across six tactical operations.

desc.en: Defend the energy core with four tower types across six future-city operations and 15–40 escalating waves.
desc.zh: 在六个未来城市作战行动中布置四类防御塔，守住能源核心，迎战 15–40 波升级攻势。

title.seo: Gravity Slingshot 引力弹弓 — Orbital Physics Puzzle

desc.meta: Gravity Slingshot 引力弹弓 — an original orbital physics game. Pull back the slingshot, bend your path around planets and capture the wormhole. 20 holes plus a daily course for the whole world.
desc.og: Pull back the slingshot, bend around planets, capture the wormhole. 20 handcrafted holes and a daily course — fewer launches, more stars.
desc.twitter: Bend your path around planets and capture the wormhole.

desc.en: Original orbital physics — slingshot your probe around planets into the wormhole. 20 holes plus a daily course.
desc.zh: 原创轨道物理——拖拽弹弓发射探测器，借行星引力甩尾进虫洞。20 个手工洞口 + 每日赛程！

title.seo: 针尖对麦芒 Pinpoint Clash: Needle vs Awn

desc.meta: 针尖对麦芒 Pinpoint Clash: Needle vs Awn — an original cyber-ink martial precision action duel. Clash tip-to-tip, weave dual stances, freeze time and awaken the thousand-awn storm!
desc.og: Clash tip-to-tip, weave dual stances of Silver Needle and Golden Awn, slow time and awaken supreme martial prowess.
desc.twitter: Clash tip-to-tip, weave dual stances, slow time and awaken supreme martial prowess.

desc.en: Clash tip-to-tip, switch stances, freeze time, and counter with pinpoint martial precision.
desc.zh: 针尖对麦芒，双姿态切换、冻结时间，以毫厘精度完成极限弹反。

title.seo: 御剑飞行 Sword Flight: Soaring Heavens

desc.meta: 御剑飞行 Sword Flight: Soaring Heavens — 国风仙侠轻功御剑动作游戏。扶摇直上九重天，踏剑破云海，御灵剑化阵，穿玄天仙环，悟无上仙道！
desc.og: 扶摇直上九重天，剑气纵横御清风。踏灵剑翱翔云海，引雷淬剑，凝万剑归宗！
desc.twitter: 扶摇直上九重天，剑气纵横御清风。踏灵剑翱翔云海，引雷淬剑，凝万剑归宗！

desc.en: Ride a flying sword through celestial rings, cleave crags, summon sword arrays, and ascend.
desc.zh: 踏剑穿越仙环与云海，斩开山岩，召出剑阵，一路破境飞升。

title.seo: 折光 Lumen — Beam Refraction Puzzle

desc.meta: 折光 Lumen — an original beam refraction puzzle. Flip mirrors, bend the beam, light up every crystal. 20 handcrafted levels plus a daily puzzle for the whole world.
desc.og: Flip mirrors, bend the beam, light every crystal. 20 handcrafted levels and a daily puzzle — light every gem with the fewest flips.
desc.twitter: Flip mirrors, bend the beam, light every crystal.

desc.en: Flip mirrors, bend the beam, light up every crystal. 20 handcrafted levels plus a daily puzzle.
desc.zh: 翻转镜面，偏折光束，点亮全部水晶。20 关手工关卡 + 每日谜题，用最少翻转通关！

title.doc: 电路谜题 Circuit — Light It Up
title.seo: 电路谜题 Circuit — Light It Up

desc.meta: 电路谜题 Circuit — a physics puzzle of switches and circuits. Flip switches, route the current, light up every target bulb — and beware the short circuit. 20 handcrafted levels plus a daily puzzle for the whole world.
desc.og: Flip switches, route the current, light every target bulb — and dodge the short circuit.
desc.twitter: Flip switches, route current, light every bulb.

desc.en: Flip switches, route the current, light every bulb — and dodge the short circuit. 20 levels plus a daily puzzle.
desc.zh: 拨动开关，接通电流，点亮全部目标灯泡——小心短路！20 关手工关卡 + 每日谜题。

title.doc: 垂丝引露 Silkfall — Rope Physics Puzzle
title.seo: 垂丝引露 Silkfall — Rope Physics Puzzle

desc.meta: 垂丝引露 Silkfall — an original rope physics puzzle. Cut the silk, swing the dewdrop past thorns and breezes, guide it into the jade vessel. 20 handcrafted levels plus a daily course for the whole world.
desc.og: Cut the silk, swing the dew, land it in the jade vessel. 20 handcrafted levels and a daily course — fewer cuts, more stars.
desc.twitter: Cut the silk, swing the dew, land it in the jade vessel.

desc.en: Thread a silk line, guide the dew pearl past thorns and gales, and drop it into the jade vessel. 20 levels + daily.
desc.zh: 牵引丝线，带露珠穿过荆棘与气旋，落入玉壶。20 关 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 键合工坊 Bond Forge — Molecule Building Puzzle
title.seo: 键合工坊 Bond Forge — Molecule Building Puzzle

desc.meta: 键合工坊 Bond Forge — an original molecule building puzzle. Drag atoms from the tray, snap them into bonds, and satisfy every valence shell to forge the target formula. 20 handcrafted levels, a daily challenge, and real chemistry along the way.
desc.og: Drag atoms, snap bonds, forge the target molecule. 20 handcrafted levels plus a daily challenge — fewer drags, more stars.
desc.twitter: Drag atoms, snap bonds, forge the molecule.

desc.en: Build target molecules by dragging atoms into bonds and satisfying every valence shell. 20 levels + daily.
desc.zh: 拖动原子成键，填满价键并拼出目标分子。20 关 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 回声洞窟 Echo Cave — Sonar Cave Puzzle
title.seo: 回声洞窟 Echo Cave — Sonar Cave Puzzle

desc.meta: 回声洞窟 Echo Cave — an original sonar puzzle. The cave is pitch black until you sing: emit pulses, watch the wavefronts bounce back off unseen walls, gather singing crystals and find the moonlit exit. 20 handcrafted caves plus a daily run for the whole world.
desc.og: Sing into the dark and read the echoes. 20 handcrafted caves — fewer pulses, more stars.
desc.twitter: Ping the darkness and read the echoes.

desc.en: Navigate a dark cave by reading echoes, collecting singing crystals, and finding the moonlit exit. 20 caves + daily.
desc.zh: 在黑暗洞窟中读回声、收集声晶并找到月光出口。20 关 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 麦克斯韦妖 Maxwell's Demon — Heat & Entropy Puzzle
title.seo: 麦克斯韦妖 Maxwell's Demon — Heat & Entropy Puzzle

desc.meta: 麦克斯韦妖 Maxwell's Demon — an original thermodynamics puzzle. Keep the tiny door between two chambers: let fast molecules into the left, shove slow ones to the right, and a real temperature gap appears out of nothing. Every glance and every open door spends budget — information is not free. 20 handcrafted vessels plus a daily run for the whole world.
desc.og: Sort fast from slow and build a temperature gap out of nothing. Every bit you learn is paid for.
desc.twitter: Keep the door. Sort the molecules. Pay for every bit you learn.

desc.en: Sort fast and slow molecules through one tiny door until a temperature gap appears. 20 vessels + daily.
desc.zh: 通过一扇小门分拣快慢分子，直到两侧出现温差。20 个容器 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 晶绽 Crystal Bloom — Cooling Curve Crystal Puzzle
title.seo: 晶绽 Crystal Bloom — Cooling Curve Crystal Puzzle

desc.meta: 晶绽 Crystal Bloom — draw a cooling curve on the temperature-time chart and grow the habit you were asked for. Cool fast and the crystal shoots needles and dendrites; cool slowly and it grows into a faceted octahedron; stir the bath to force compact blocks. Every anchor you place and every stir you buy costs points — 20 vessels plus a daily run for the whole world.
desc.og: Draw a cooling curve. Grow the crystal. Fast makes needles, slow makes facets.
desc.twitter: Your cooling curve is the crystal's temper — draw it well and pay as little as you can.

desc.en: Draw a cooling curve: quench for dendrites, cool gently for facets. 20 crystallization vessels + daily.
desc.zh: 画出降温曲线：急冷长枝晶，缓冷推晶面。20 个结晶皿 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 焰语 Flame Verse — Flame Spectrum Puzzle
title.seo: 焰语 Flame Verse — Flame Spectrum Puzzle

desc.meta: 焰语 Flame Verse — an original flame spectroscopy puzzle. Throw salts into the burner, watch the flame speak in color, read the emission lines each element leaves behind and match the mystery sample's barcode of light. 20 unknowns plus a daily sample for the whole world.
desc.og: Throw salt into the flame and it speaks the element's name. Read the lines, match the barcode of light.
desc.twitter: Every element has a fingerprint of light. Learn to read it.

desc.en: Read each salt's emission-line barcode to identify the element and its dose. 20 samples + daily.
desc.zh: 读取盐样的发射谱线条码，判断元素与含量。20 份样品 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 涟漪双生 Ripple Duet — Wave Interference Puzzle
title.seo: 涟漪双生 Ripple Duet — Wave Interference Puzzle

desc.meta: 涟漪双生 Ripple Duet — an original wave interference puzzle. Drag two sources across the sea, set their phase, and sculpt the ripple field: flatten the storm at one point, blaze a beacon at another, keep a whole channel calm. 20 wave puzzles plus a daily course for the whole world.
desc.og: Two sources, one sea. Sculpt the interference pattern — flatten here, blaze there.
desc.twitter: Every calm spot on the water is a coincidence you built on purpose.

desc.en: Move two wave sources and tune phase to cancel waves here and reinforce them there. 20 puzzles + daily.
desc.zh: 移动两个波源并调节相位，让这里相消、那里相长。20 个干涉谜题 + 每日挑战。

title.doc: 拔萝卜 Carrot Pull — Garden Rhythm Game
title.seo: 拔萝卜 Carrot Pull — Garden Rhythm Game

desc.meta: 拔萝卜 Carrot Pull — a playful garden rhythm game. Press in the sweet spot, build a pulling streak, and help a tiny mole harvest six giant carrots before time runs out.
desc.og: Find the sweet spot, pull in rhythm, and harvest the garden.
desc.twitter: Pull in rhythm, keep your streak, and harvest six giant carrots.

desc.en: Find the sweet spot, pull in rhythm, and help a tiny mole harvest six giant carrots before time runs out.
desc.zh: 看准绿色甜蜜区，跟着节奏用力拔，和小鼹鼠一起在时间结束前收获 6 根大萝卜。

title.doc: 萤火信号 Firefly Signal — Synchrony Puzzle
title.seo: 萤火信号 Firefly Signal — Synchrony Puzzle

desc.meta: 萤火信号 Firefly Signal — a midsummer-night synchrony puzzle. Every firefly blinks to its own rhythm; nudge just a few of them and watch whole meadows fall into step until the entire field lights up at once.
desc.og: Nudge a few fireflies. Watch the whole meadow blink as one.
desc.twitter: Every firefly blinks alone — until you find the one that connects them.

desc.en: Every firefly blinks alone. Nudge a few and watch whole meadows fall into step until the field lights up as one.
desc.zh: 每只萤火虫都各闪各的。轻轻推动几只，看一片片草地渐渐合拍，直到整片原野同时亮起。

title.doc: 影织 Shadow Loom — Paper Shadow Puzzle
title.seo: 影织 Shadow Loom — Paper Shadow Puzzle

desc.meta: 影织 Shadow Loom — a quiet paper-theatre puzzle. Move paper cut-outs hung at different depths, and the lamp itself, until their scattered shadows weave into a rabbit, a dove, a deer — and the shadow comes alive.
desc.og: Move paper cut-outs and a lamp until scattered shadows weave into a living shape.
desc.twitter: A paper-theatre puzzle of light, depth and shadow: weave the pieces into a living silhouette.

desc.en: Move paper cut-outs hung at different depths — and the lamp — until their scattered shadows weave into a living shape.
desc.zh: 移动悬在不同深度的剪纸和那盏灯，让散乱的影子慢慢重合，织成一个会动的生命。
